environment.description: Same ECS Fargate task deployed in the shared-services OU (ou-abc1-sharedsvcs) of AWS Organizations. The task role arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/order-consumer-role has an attached IAM permission boundary policy (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:policy/WorkloadCeilingBoundary) that contains an explicit Deny on sts:AssumeRole, iam:*, and s3:GetObject with a StringNotEquals condition on aws:PrincipalOrgID. Additionally, the OU has SCP sid 'DenyCredentialExfiltration' which denies s3:PutObject when the s3:prefix begins with 'audit-logs/' AND the object size exceeds 512 bytes, using a NumericGreaterThan condition on s3:content-length-range. The SQS queue has a redrive policy sending failed messages to a DLQ after 1 attempt. The ECS task definition sets environment variable AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=DISABLED and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=DISABLED (overriding SDK credential chain to force IMDSv2 task credential endpoint only). Container uses a read-only root filesystem with /tmp mounted as a 10MB tmpfs with noexec.

config.scp_policy: DenyCredentialExfiltration - denies s3:PutObject when prefix=audit-logs/ AND content-length > 512 bytes
config.network: VPC endpoints for SQS and S3 only, no internet egress
